name: Onboarding: a new user registers and reaches the Daily Quest screen

planSteps.description: Open the app at / and wait up to 30 seconds for the '[ SYSTEM ]' window to appear (a Flutter web app; it can take a while to load, and controls are exposed in the accessibility tree)
A window titled '[ SYSTEM ]' is visible with the text 'Candidate detected.' and a button 'BEGIN REGISTRATION'
A '[ DAILY QUEST ]' setup window is visible with three 'Objective name' text boxes and a 'CONFIRM OBJECTIVES' button
A '[ LOCK TARGETS ]' window is visible with a 'CONFIRM APPS' button (the web build lists no apps; that is expected)
A '[ REST PERIOD ]' window is visible with buttons '11:00 PM', '7:00 AM' and 'CONFIRM'
A '[ PENALTY TERMS ]' window is visible with a 'HOLD TO ACCEPT' button
Click the 'HOLD TO ACCEPT' button once (this test build accepts a single click in place of the hold)
The app shows the '[ DAILY QUEST ]' screen listing the objectives 'Have breakfast', 'Study' and 'Read', and a bottom bar with 'QUEST', 'STATUS' and 'PENALTY'
